```{r}

#################################################
# Function: Generates a density of age stratified by subclade
# Author: Elgin Akin
# Description: This script ingests tabular data with 2 column with 2 columns Age and Subtype
#################################################

# -------Simulate some JHH Age Data --------
set.seed(123) 
ages_C3 <- round(rnorm(50, mean = 15, sd = 10)) 
ages_C3 <- pmax(pmin(ages_C3, 70), 0)
ages_C5 <- round(rnorm(50, mean = 55, sd = 10)) 
ages_C5 <- pmax(pmin(ages_C5, 70), 0) 

# Create simulated data frame. 
df <- data.frame(age = c(ages_C3, ages_C5),subclade = rep(c("C.3", "C.5"), each = 50))

# ------- Uncomment to import ACTUAL age data  --------

# df <- read.csv("age_data.csv") # uncomment this line to import the actual age dataframe

#################################################

# ------- Load packages -------- 
packages <- c("ggpubr", "tidyverse", "gt")

# Install any packages that are not already installed
installed <- packages %in% rownames(installed.packages())
if (any(!installed)) {
  install.packages(packages[!installed])
}

# Load packages
lapply(packages, library, character.only = TRUE)

# ------- PLOT DENSITY PLOT -------- 
# Density plot with mean lines and marginal rug

density <- ggdensity(df,
                      x = "age", 
                      add = "median", 
                      rug = TRUE,
                      color = "subclade", 
                      fill = "subclade",
                      legend = "right",
                      palette = c("#2E6F40", "#FF6961"))

# ------- PLOT VIOLIN PLOT -------- 

violin <- ggviolin(df, 
                  x = "subclade",
                  y = "age",
                  fill = "subclade",
                  width = 0.5,
                  legend = "right",
                  add = "median_iqr",
                  error.plot = c("crossbar"),
                  palette = c("#2E6F40", "#FF6961")) +
                  stat_kruskal_test(aes(group = subclade), label = "p = {p.format}{p.signif}")

# ------- PLOT BOXPLOT --------  
boxplot <- ggboxplot(df, 
                    x = "subclade",
                    y = "age",
                    width = 0.4,
                    fill = "subclade", 
                    legend = "right",
                    palette = c("#2E6F40", "#FF6961")) +
                    stat_kruskal_test(aes(group = subclade), label = "p = {p.format}{p.signif}")

# ------- PLOT SUMMARY STATS PLOT -----
summarystats <- ggsummarystats(df,
                                x = "subclade",
                                y = "age",
                                ggfunc = ggbarplot, 
                                width = 0.4,
                                summaries = c("n", "mean", "median", "iqr"),
                                add = c("jitter", "median_iqr"),
                                color = "subclade", 
                                palette = c("#2E6F40", "#FF6961"))


# ------- Calculate Mean, Median and quartile ranges --------

res <- desc_statby(df, measure.var = "age",
   grps = c("subclade")) 

# Select and pivot relevant statistics
res_pivot <- res |>
  select(subclade, length, min, max, median,iqr, mean, sd) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -subclade,
    names_to = "statistic",
    values_to = "value"
  ) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = subclade,
    values_from = value
  )

# Pretty table with gt
statistics <- res_pivot |>
              gt() |>
              tab_spanner(
                label = "Subclade",
                columns = c(C.3, C.5)
              ) |> 
              fmt_number(
                columns = where(is.numeric),
                decimals = 2
              ) |>
              cols_label(
                statistic = "Statistic",
                `C.3` = "C.3",
                `C.5` = "C.5"
              ) |> 
              gtsave("figures/statistics.docx") # save statistics plot

# ------- SAVE DENSITY PLOT -------- 
# you'll need to make a figures/directory if you have not already. 

ggsave("figures/age_density.jpeg", density, height = 3, width = 4)
ggsave("figures/age_violinplot.jpeg", violin, height = 3, width = 3)
ggsave("figures/age_boxplot.jpeg", boxplot, height = 3, width = 3)
ggexport(summarystats, filename = "figures/statistics.png", height = 800, width = 800, res = 200)

# ------- VIEW PLOTS -------- 

density
violin
boxplot
summarystats


```


## Goodness of fit


```{r}
# ---- NORMALITY TESTS (Shapiro-Wilk) ----
shapiro_C3 <- shapiro.test(df$age[df$subclade == "C.3"])
shapiro_C5 <- shapiro.test(df$age[df$subclade == "C.5"])

cat("Shapiro-Wilk test for C.3:\n")
print(shapiro_C3)

cat("\nShapiro-Wilk test for C.5:\n")
print(shapiro_C5)

# ---- HISTOGRAM + NORMAL CURVE OVERLAY ----
plot_normal_overlay <- function(data, label, color) {
  ggplot(data, aes(x = age)) +
    geom_histogram(aes(y = ..density..), bins = 10, fill = color, alpha = 0.5) +
    stat_function(fun = dnorm,
                  args = list(mean = mean(data$age), sd = sd(data$age)),
                  color = "black", size = 1.2) +
    labs(title = paste("Histogram with Normal Curve:", label),
         x = "Age", y = "Density") +
    theme_minimal()
}

hist_C3 <- plot_normal_overlay(df[df$subclade == "C.3", ], "C.3", "#2E6F40")
hist_C5 <- plot_normal_overlay(df[df$subclade == "C.5", ], "C.5", "#FF6961")

# ---- Q-Q PLOTS ----
qq_C3 <- ggqqplot(df[df$subclade == "C.3", ]$age,
                  color = "#2E6F40", title = "Q-Q Plot: C.3")

qq_C5 <- ggqqplot(df[df$subclade == "C.5", ]$age,
                  color = "#FF6961", title = "Q-Q Plot: C.5")

# ---- DISPLAY ALL PLOTS ----
library(patchwork)
(hist_C3 | qq_C3) / (hist_C5 | qq_C5)

```



```{r}
# Run Shapiro-Wilk normality tests
shapiro_C3 <- shapiro.test(df$age[df$subclade == "C.3"])
shapiro_C5 <- shapiro.test(df$age[df$subclade == "C.5"])

# Create a new row with Shapiro-Wilk p-values
normality_row <- tibble(
  statistic = "Shapiro-Wilk p-value",
  `C.3` = shapiro_C3$p.value,
  `C.5` = shapiro_C5$p.value
)


# Original summary
res_pivot <- res |>
  select(subclade, length, min, max, median, iqr, mean, sd) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -subclade,
    names_to = "statistic",
    values_to = "value"
  ) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = subclade,
    values_from = value
  )

# Append normality test row
res_with_normality <- bind_rows(res_pivot, normality_row)

statistics <- res_with_normality |>
  gt() |>
  tab_spanner(
    label = "Subclade",
    columns = c(`C.3`, `C.5`)
  ) |>
  fmt_number(
    columns = where(is.numeric),
    decimals = 4
  ) |>
  cols_label(
    statistic = "Statistic",
    `C.3` = "C.3",
    `C.5` = "C.5"
  ) 


```
